name: paircode
description: paircode — adversarial journey framework for multi-LLM peer review. Registers /paircode as a slash command.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial peer review across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Ollama.
interface.longDescription: paircode orchestrates multi-LLM peer review — one primary LLM plus any number of peer LLMs running research, plan, and execute stages with structured cross-review. File-traces on disk. Install the paircode Python package separately via `pip install paircode` or `pipx install paircode`.
